title: ICA-UAP-D001, Analysis: Colorado Springs UAP Incident, 2022
what_is_it: An intelligence community analysis document examining a 2022 UAP incident near Colorado Springs, Colorado, produced by an AARO partner agency.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted body text was available from the PDF (likely scanned/OCR-poor); all facts are derived from metadata and the CSV description only.
The assessment is explicitly low-confidence, meaning the IC partner itself considers the sunlight-backscattering explanation uncertain.
The incident remains officially unresolved — the proposed explanation has not been accepted as definitive.
There was a one-year gap between the incident (2022) and the report to AARO (2023), which may affect witness recall accuracy.
Redaction level is estimated as moderate based on the inability to extract text, but actual redaction extent within the document is unknown without visual inspection.
